proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: with the groupoid diagrams of lemma-diagram-pull and the definition of the invariants C, both rows of the comparison diagram are equalizer diagrams (the top row because condition (2) makes s faithfully flat, by the descent lemma; the lower row by definition of C); inserting the x_i produces a commutative diagram whose middle vertical arrow is an isomorphism by assumption; cocartesianity of the left squares makes the left arrow an isomorphism and exactness of the rows forces the right arrow to be an isomorphism, which says exactly that A is the direct sum of the Cx_i and B = A (x)_C A (source lines 4976-5030)

core_obligations: Diagram set-up (proof lines 4980-5003): the comparison diagram from 03C6 has cocartesian left squares and, using faithful flatness of s implied by (2), the top row is an equalizer diagram (023M); the lower row is an equalizer by the definition of C (03BF).

Inserting the basis (proof lines 5005-5021): the x_i induce the vertical arrows (right: x_i -> x_i, middle: x_i -> t(x_i), left: x_i -> c(t(x_i)) = p_0(t(x_i)) using 02YE); the diagram commutes and the middle arrow is an isomorphism by assumption (2).

Conclusion (proof lines 5021-5030): cocartesianity makes the left arrow an isomorphism; both rows are exact (equalizers), so the right arrow is an isomorphism, i.e. A = (x)_{i in I} C x_i and B = A (x)_C A.
proof_roadmap: Assemble the cocartesian/equalizer diagram for the groupoid rings (proof lines 4980-5003).
Insert the x_i data and verify commutativity and the middle isomorphism (proof lines 5005-5021).
Conclude by cocartesianity and exactness of the rows (proof lines 5021-5030).
